item.title: Mayor Fouts mocks Santorum’s disabled child as a ‘mongoloid baby’ with ‘her tongue hanging out’
item.description: Warren Mayor Jim Fouts mocked the disabled daughter of former presidential candidate Rick Santorum as a “mongoloid baby” who’s “got her tongue hanging out the side and all kinds of shit.”

item.title: That time Martin Luther King Jr. defied hecklers in Grosse Pointe speech in 1968
item.description: Three weeks before his assassination, Martin Luther King Jr. looked nervous. Those close to him noticed that his normally steady hands were shaking. His forehead glistened in sweat.

item.title: Part 1: Detroit dupes public with false police response times as 911 calls spike
item.description: Motor City Muckraker and Deadline Detroit collaborated on a series about Detroit's declining police services. This is part 1.

item.title: Part 2: Numbers are boring. But in Detroit, they’re a matter of life and death
item.description: Myra Lanton and her family are the flesh and blood people behind Detroit’s crime statistics.

item.title: Iconic Packard Plant bridge collapses onto E. Grand Blvd. in Detroit
item.description: The iconic Packard Plant bridge collapsed onto East Grand Boulevard late Wednesday afternoon.

item.title: Part 3: Anatomy of a murder scene: What really happened in Detroit that night
item.description: It was a gory scene. The driver of a van had a fatal gunshot wound to the head. His seat belt was unfastened. A woman covered in blood was hysterical. The passenger door was open. Police were nowhere to be seen.

item.title: Part 4: Police response times are slowest in Detroit’s poorest neighborhoods
item.description: How fast do police come when you call? That depends on where you live. And if you live in Detroit's poorest, most crime-ridden neighborhoods, you're likely going to wait for a long time.
